mn39:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati assapuraṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
mn39:2.1: samaṇā samaṇāti vo bhikkhave jano sañjānāti
mn39:2.2: tumhe ca pana ke tumheti puṭṭhā samānā samaṇamhāti paṭijānātha
mn39:2.3: tesaṃ vo bhikkhave evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma evanno ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā
mn39:2.4: yesañca mayaṃ cīvara piṇḍapāta senāsana gilānapaccaya- bhesajjaparikkhāre paribhuñjāma tesante kārā amhesu mahapphalā bhavissanti mahānisaṃsā amhākañcevāyaṃ pabbajjā avañjhā bhavissati saphalā saudrayāti
mn39:3.1: katame ca bhikkhave dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca.
mn39:3.2: hirottappena samannāgatā bhavissāmāti evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti.
mn39:3.3: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa

mn39:10.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāmāti evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ.

mn39:11.3: siyā kho pana bhikkhave tumhākaṃ evamassa

mn39:12.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn39:13.1: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn39:13.2: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.3: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.4: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.5: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:13.6: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn39:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojeyya
mn39:14.3: so yāni ca porāṇāni iṇamūlāni tāni ca byantīkareyya siyā cassa uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārābharaṇāya.
mn39:14.5: ahaṃ kho pubbe iṇaṃ ādāya kammante payojesiṃ tassa me te kammantā sampajjiṃsu
mn39:14.6: sohaṃ yāni ca porāṇāni tāni ca byantīakāsiṃ atthi ca pana me uttariṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ dārābharaṇāyāti.
mn39:14.7: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso ābādhiko assa dukkhito bāḷhagilāno bhattañcassa na chādeyya na cassa kāye balamattā.
mn39:14.9: so aparena samayena tamhā ābādhā mucceyya bhattañcassa chādeyya siyā cassa kāye balamattā.
mn39:14.11: ahaṃ kho pubbe ābādhiko ahosiṃ dukkhito bāḷhagilāno bhattañca me na chādesi na ca me āsi kāye balamattā somhi etarahi tamhā ābādhā mutto bhattañca me chādesi atthi ca me kāye balamattāti.
mn39:14.12: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso bandhanāgāre bandho assa.
mn39:14.14: so aparena samayena tamhā bandhanā mucceyya sotthinā abhayena na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo.
mn39:14.16: ahaṃ kho pubbe bandhanāgāre bandho ahosiṃ somhi etarahi tamhā bandhanā mutto sotthinā abhayena natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayoti.
mn39:14.17: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.18: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso dāso assa anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo.
mn39:14.19: so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamo.
mn39:14.21: ahaṃ kho pubbe dāso ahosiṃ anattādhīno parādhīno na yenakāmaṅgamo somhi etarahi tamhā dasabyā mutto attādhīno aparādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṅgamoti.
mn39:14.22: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.23: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjeyya.
mn39:14.24: so aparena samayena tamhā kantārā nitthareyya sotthinā abhayena na cassa kiñci bhogānaṃ vayo.
mn39:14.26: ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantāraddhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ
mn39:14.27: somhi etarahi tamhā kantārā nitthiṇṇo sotthinā abhayena natthi ca me kiñci bhogānaṃ vayoti.
mn39:14.28: so tatonidānaṃ labhetha pāmujjaṃ adhigaccheyya somanassaṃ.
mn39:14.29: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yathā iṇaṃ yathā rogaṃ yathā bandhanāgāraṃ yathā dāsabyaṃ yathā kantāraddhānamaggaṃ ime pañca nīvaraṇe appahīne attani samanupassati.
mn39:14.30: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yathā ānaṇaññaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanā mokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khemantabhūmi evameva kho bhikkhu ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanuppassati.
mn39:15.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn39:15.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:15.3: so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:15.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākīritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sanneyya sāyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi sinehānuggatā sinehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭṭhā sinehena na ca paggharaṇī
mn39:15.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:16.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:16.2: so imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:16.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave udakarahado gambhīro ubbhidodako tassa nevassa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na pacchimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na uttarāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ na dakkhiṇāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ devo pana kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anupaveccheyya atha kho tamhā ca udakarahadā sītā vāridhārā ubbhijjitvā tameva udakarahadaṃ sītena vārinā abhisanneyya parisanneyya paripūreyya paripphareyya nāssa kiñci sabbāvato udakarahadassa sītena vārinā apphutaṃ assa
mn39:16.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ samādhijena pītisukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa samādhijena pītisukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:17.2: so imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:17.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggapositāni yāva ca aggā yāva ca mūlā sītena vārinā abhisannāni parisannāni paripūrāni paripphutāni nāssa kiñci sabbāvataṃ uppalānaṃ vā padumānaṃ vā puṇḍarīkānaṃ vā sītena vārinā apphutaṃ assa
mn39:17.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ nippītikena sukhena abhisanneti parisanneti paripūreti parippharati nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa nippītikena sukhena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:18.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassa domanassānaṃ aṭṭhaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn39:18.2: so imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:18.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso odātena vatthena sīsaṃ pārupitvā nisinno assa nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa odātena vatthena apphutaṃ assa
mn39:18.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena pharitvā nisinno hoti nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa parisuddhena cetasā pariyodātena apphutaṃ hoti.
mn39:19.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn39:19.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn39:19.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso sakamhā gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya tamhāpi gāmā aññaṃ gāmaṃ gaccheyya tamhāpi gāmā sakaṃyeva gāmaṃ paccāgaccheyya tassa evamassa ahaṃ kho sakamhā gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agañchiṃ tatra evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ tamhāpi gāmā amuṃ gāmaṃ agañchiṃ tatrapi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ somhi tamhā gāmā sakaṃyeva gāmaṃ paccāgatoti
mn39:19.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn39:20.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn39:20.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn39:20.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave dve agārā sadvārā tattha cakkhumā puriso majjhe ṭhito passeyya manusse gehaṃ pavisantepi nikkhamantepi anucaṅkamantepi anusañcarantepi anuvicarantepi
mn39:20.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn39:21.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn39:21.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
mn39:21.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn39:21.4: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati
mn39:21.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn39:21.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pabbatasaṅkhepe udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo
mn39:21.8: tattha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippika sambukampi sakkhara kaṭhalampi macchagumbampi tiṭṭhantaṃpi carantaṃpi.
mn39:21.10: ayaṃ kho udakarahado accho vippasanno anāvilo tatrime sippika sambukāpi sakkhara kaṭhalāpi macchagumbāpi tiṭṭhantipi carantipīti
mn39:21.11: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti …pe…
mn39:22.1: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu samaṇo itipi brāhmaṇo itipi nhātako itipi vedagū itipi sottiyo itipi ariyo itipi arahā itipi.
mn39:23.2: samitāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:23.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu samaṇo hoti.
mn39:24.2: bāhitāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:24.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu brāhmaṇo hoti.
mn39:25.2: nhātāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:25.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu nhātako hoti.
mn39:26.2: viditāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:26.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti.
mn39:27.2: nissutāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:27.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sottiyo hoti.
mn39:28.2: ārakāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:28.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo hoti.
mn39:29.2: ārakāssa honti pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobbhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇīyā
mn39:29.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu arahā hotīti.
mn39:29.5: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
